items.title: 8.8.1 Equilibrium constant expressions of some important reactions (kuch important reactions ke Kc expressions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.8.1, printed pages 174-176, with Quick Check 8.4 as self-checks.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 8.1
blocks.problem: Ethanol aur ethanoic acid react kar ke ethyl ethanoate aur pani banate hain: CH₃COOH(l) + C₂H₅OH(l) ⇌ CH₃COOC₂H₅(l) + H₂O(l). Equilibrium par 500 cm³ mixture mein 0.235 mol ethanoic acid, 0.0350 mol ethanol, 0.182 mol ethyl ethanoate aur 0.182 mol pani hai. Kc nikalein. Given: 0.235 mol ethanoic acid, 0.0350 mol ethanol, 0.182 mol ester, 0.182 mol pani, volume 500 cm³. Required: Kc = ?
steps: Step 1: Har cheez ke moles ko volume se divide kar ke concentration nikalein (500 cm³ = 0.5 dm³). CH₃COOH: 0.235 / 0.5 = 0.470 mol dm⁻³; C₂H₅OH: 0.0350 / 0.5 = 0.070 mol dm⁻³; CH₃COOC₂H₅: 0.182 / 0.5 = 0.364 mol dm⁻³; H₂O: 0.182 / 0.5 = 0.364 mol dm⁻³.
Step 2: Kc likhein, products oopar aur reactants neeche: Kc = [CH₃COOC₂H₅][H₂O] / [CH₃COOH][C₂H₅OH] = (0.364)(0.364) / (0.470)(0.070).
Step 4: Units: oopar mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³ aur neeche bhi mol dm⁻³ × mol dm⁻³, is liye units cancel ho jati hain aur Kc ki koi unit nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Step 2 mein pani ki concentration 0.0364 mol dm⁻³ chhapi hai. Step 1 mein yeh 0.364 mol dm⁻³ hai, aur jawab 4.03 bhi sirf 0.364 se aata hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 8.2
blocks.problem: Propanone hydrogen cyanide se react karta hai: CH₃COCH₃(l) + HCN(g) ⇌ CH₃C(OH)(CN)CH₃(l). 0.0500 mol dm⁻³ propanone aur 0.0500 mol dm⁻³ HCN ka mixture room temperature par equilibrium tak pohanchta hai. Equilibrium par product ki concentration 0.0233 mol dm⁻³ hai. Kc nikalein. Given: shuru mein [propanone] = [HCN] = 0.0500 mol dm⁻³; equilibrium par [product] = 0.0233 mol dm⁻³. Required: Kc = ?
steps: Step 1: Equation ke neeche data likhein. Shuru mein: propanone 0.0500, HCN 0.0500, product 0. Equilibrium par: propanone ?, HCN ?, product 0.0233 mol dm⁻³.
Step 2: Har mole product banne par 1 mole CH₃COCH₃ aur 1 mole HCN kharch hota hai. Is liye equilibrium par dono: 0.0500 − 0.0233 = 0.0267 mol dm⁻³.
Step 4: Calculation (hisaab): 0.0233 / 0.000713 = 32.7. Unit: oopar ek concentration aur neeche do, is liye unit (mol dm⁻³)⁻¹ yani mol⁻¹ dm³.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Step 3 mein propanone ko CH₃COH₃ likha hai (sahi CH₃COCH₃), aur expression mein equilibrium concentrations (0.0267) ki jagah shuru ki concentrations (0.05) rakh di hain. 0.0233 / (0.05 × 0.05) = 9.32 banta hai, jabke kitab ka jawab 32.7 sirf 0.0267 se aata hai. Kitab ne unit mol dm⁻³ likhi hai; sahi unit mol⁻¹ dm³ hai.
a) In reactions ke liye Kc likhein:

blocks.prompt: a) Teenon reactions ke liye Kc likhein.
blocks.explanation: (i) Kc = [Sn⁴⁺][Fe²⁺]² / [Sn²⁺][Fe³⁺]². (ii) Kc = [NO]⁴[H₂O]⁶ / [NH₃]⁴[O₂]⁵. (iii) Kc = [PCl₃][Cl₂] / [PCl₅]. Har concentration par us ka coefficient power hai; products oopar, reactants neeche.

blocks.text: b) Neeche di gayi information (maloomat) se is reaction ka Kc nikalein:

items: H₂(g) ki shuru ki concentration = 10.00 mol dm⁻³.
CO₂(g) ki shuru ki concentration = 10.00 mol dm⁻³.
CO(g) ki equilibrium concentration = 9.47 mol dm⁻³.

blocks.prompt: b) Kc ki value kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Har mole CO banne par H₂ aur CO₂ ka ek ek mole kharch hota hai aur H₂O ka ek mole banta hai. Equilibrium par [CO] = [H₂O] = 9.47 aur [H₂] = [CO₂] = 10.00 − 9.47 = 0.53 mol dm⁻³. Kc = (9.47 × 9.47) / (0.53 × 0.53) = 89.7 / 0.281 = 319. Dono taraf moles barabar hain, is liye koi unit nahi.

items: Ammonia: Kc = [NH₃]² / [N₂][H₂]³; N₂O₅ ka decomposition: Kc = [NO₂]⁴[O₂] / [N₂O₅]².
Sample 8.1: moles ÷ 0.5 dm³ se concentrations, Kc = 4.03, koi unit nahi.
Sample 8.2: har reactant mein se bana hua product minus karein, Kc = 0.0233 / 0.0267² = 32.7 mol⁻¹ dm³.
